notebooks.title: 终端接续与反例核对

cells.code:
r = plan(2)
assert r is not None
shift = np.array([r['u'][1], -.6*r['states'][2]])
shift_states = np.array([r['states'][1], r['states'][2], .6*r['states'][2]])
candidate_cost = shift_states[0]**2+shift[0]**2+shift_states[1]**2+shift[1]**2+P*shift_states[2]**2
next_plan = plan(r['states'][1])
print('default_U',r['u'],'default_states',r['states'],'default_value',r['cost'])
print('shift_U',shift,'shift_states',shift_states,'candidate_cost',candidate_cost)
print('next_U',next_plan['u'],'next_value',next_plan['cost'],'value_difference',next_plan['cost']-r['cost'])
assert np.allclose(r['u'],[-1,-1],atol=1e-9)
assert abs(candidate_cost-(r['cost']-5))<1e-10
assert next_plan['cost']<=candidate_cost+1e-10
grid=np.linspace(-1.5,1.5,121)
assert np.all(np.abs(-.6*grid)<=1+1e-12)
assert np.max(np.abs(P*((.6*grid)**2-grid**2)+(grid**2+(-.6*grid)**2)))<1e-12
print('terminal_P',P,'local_decay_coefficient',P*(.36-1),'terminal_max_radius',5/3)
print('predecessor_bounds',1,5/3,20/9)
print('r_half_bound',(.5+2.2)/1.44,'r_onehalf_bound',(1.5+2.2)/1.44)

# A different model for the one-step trap: x+=2x+u, |x|<=2, |u|<=1.
for x in [0.,1.,1.4]:
    lower=max(-1.,-2.-2*x); upper=min(1.,2.-2*x)
    u=float(np.clip(0.,lower,upper)); next_x=2*x+u
    possible_next=(max(-1.,-2.-2*next_x)<=min(1.,2.-2*next_x))
    print('trap_case',x,'u',u,'next',next_x,'next_feasible',possible_next)
assert abs((2*1.4-.8)-2)<1e-12
for x,w in [(2.,.75),(2.2,.75),(0.,0.)]:
    old=plan(x); measured=old['states'][1]+w
    shifted=np.array([old['u'][1],-.6*old['states'][2]])
    end=1.44*measured+1.2*shifted[0]+shifted[1]
    fresh=plan(measured)
    print('mismatch_case',x,w,'measured',measured,'shift_end',end,'fresh_feasible',fresh is not None)
print('failure_cases_checked')

notebooks.title: 名义闭环与值函数

cells.code:
state=2.; trajectory=[state]; inputs=[]; values=[]; residuals=[]
plans=[]
for k in range(20):
    r=plan(state)
    if r is None: raise RuntimeError('Nominal loop unexpectedly infeasible')
    plans.append(dict(x=state,u=r['u'].tolist()))
    values.append(r['cost']);residuals.append(r['residual'])
    inputs.append(float(r['u'][0]));state=1.2*state+r['u'][0];trajectory.append(float(state))
last=plan(state);values.append(last['cost'])
stages=np.array(trajectory[:-1])**2+np.array(inputs)**2
descent=np.diff(values)+stages
assert max(descent)<1e-8
print('closed_loop_steps',len(inputs),'last_sample',trajectory[-1])
print('max_KKT',max(residuals),'max_descent_residual',max(descent))
print('max_state',max(abs(np.array(trajectory))),'max_input',max(abs(np.array(inputs))))

t=np.arange(21)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(9,6))
axes[0].plot(t,trajectory,'o-',label='nominal sampled x')
axes[0].axhline(1,color='gray',ls='--');axes[0].axhline(-1,color='gray',ls='--')
axes[0].set(xlim=(0,20),ylim=(-3,3),ylabel='state');axes[0].legend();axes[0].grid(True)
axes[1].plot(t,values,'o-',label='optimal V2')
axes[1].set(xlim=(0,20),ylim=(0,10),xlabel='sample k',ylabel='value');axes[1].legend();axes[1].grid(True)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('sample_axes_0_to_20','terminal_radius',1,'not_a_steady_state_proof')
